title: [review] node.rs echo responder: promiscuous 2000::/3 arm; should answer only node identities (link-local + 0200::/7 AddrForKey)
description: Discovered from i72x.4 (ULA sweep). rust/lichen-node/src/node.rs echo-reply conditions (Node::handle_ipv6 ~line 195 and the RplNode ICMPv6 branch ~line 526) answer ICMPv6 echo when dst == link-local OR (dst[0] & 0xe0) == 0x20 (2000::/3 GUA). The 0xfd ULA arm was removed in i72x.4; the 2000::/3 arm remains and is equally promiscuous: any node answers pings to ANY 2000::/3 address, and (dst[0]&0xe0)==0x20 never matches the node's real 0200::/7 identity (0x02 & 0xe0 = 0). Correct end state: reply only when dst equals one of the node's own addresses — link-local or its upstream AddrForKey 0200::/7 identity. Blocked on i72x.2 (Rust lichen-core addr.rs migration to upstream AddrForKey) landing a NodeId/identity accessor for the node's ygg address; until then the arm is retained with a comment at both sites. When i72x.2 lands: replace both conditions with exact identity checks and add a test that a ping to a foreign 0200::/8 address is not answered.
